policy_ingestion.surface: permission key: 'allow'|'ask'|'deny' globally, per tool-key, or per tool-key as {pattern: effect} objects. Per-agent permission overrides merged with AGENT RULES TAKING PRECEDENCE; markdown agent frontmatter permission: blocks. Tool keys: read/edit/glob/grep/list/shell/task/external_directory/webfetch/websearch/lsp/skill/question/doom_loop. Pattern matching: simple wildcards (* = zero+ chars, ? = exactly one, else literal; ~/ $HOME expansion). LAST MATCHING RULE WINS (order-dependent — unlike Claude/Cursor deny-first).
